Smoke test: XLSX with basic spreadsheet data including tables

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet', uri: 'https://example.com/xlsx/stanley_cups.xlsx'), {  })
puts result.results[0].mime_type.inspect
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
puts result.results[0].tables.inspect
puts result.results[0].metadata.format.excel.sheet_count.inspect
puts result.results[0].metadata.format.excel.sheet_names.inspect
```
